items.html: And afterward, when they entered the womb of their mother Bina, in the secret of pregnancy as mentioned above, they were corrected and made into a private domain, whose height is ten and whose width is four. And the matter is that they were joined and bound and grasped one within the other and clothed one within the other, as explained well above in the discourse on Atik and Arich, see there. And then all six extremities are called one united Partzuf, called ZA, whose height is ten, which are the letters in the filling of Alfin, whose width is four, which are the four letters of HaVaYaH that are in ZA, as is known.
